note: Riverside-bluff RV park north of Buena Vista on US-24, overlooking the Arkansas River with Collegiate Peaks views and walk-down river access (kayaking, fishing, gold panning). ~46 sites, big-rig friendly. Also a primitive camper cabin, tent sites and a large group site. Main drawback is US-24 highway noise. --Claude
summary: Operator's rates page (modified 2026-07-08): peak (Apr-Sep) $47 30-amp / $53 50-amp full hookup, off-peak call; no booking engine (phone/email/contact form, one-night deposit). Confirmed 50 A full hookups, pull-throughs; added showers/flush/laundry/dump/wifi and booking platform phone with note. Cleared the 46-site count (sweep note only). Year-round left (no explicit statement; off-peak prices listed). Military discount (Good Sam directory) not stated by the operator, left. Note trimmed.
flags: Price gate: base $47/night (peak 30-amp full hookup, 2026 page), under US$50; no engine to quote. Nearest gateway irrelevant at that price. Presence: own site + phone 719-395-8883 (matches), Google Maps 4.2 / 177 reviews.

Waterfront re-audit lead (operator claim stronger than stored 'riverview'): the operator says it is 'the only park in the upper Arkansas River Valley that sets adjacent to the Arkansas River' with 'River Access'. Esri imagery (z18) shows the sites on an open flat between US-24 and a band of conifers; the river runs ~60-90 m east of the nearest sites, behind those trees. Not riverfront on the imagery; stored riverview looks right (and may be generous where the trees block the view).
The operator says the park is 'about 6 miles north of Buena Vista'; the note had ~4.5 mi (dropped).
